For this FRL, India applied a forest definition of lands larger than 1 hectare with tree canopy density above 10% irrespective of ownership or legal status (including orchards, bamboo and palm).  The FRL includes all five carbon pools (above- and below-ground biomass, deadwood, litter and soil organic carbon) and reports only CO2.  The UNFCCC technical assessment noted that the information provided was only partially transparent and not complete, and identified areas for future technical improvement.  == See also == Environmental issues in India == Notes == == References ==
